artifact_kind: One-click Windows installers plus a CurseForge-compatible modpack ZIP

preferred_launcher.name: Bundled portable Prism Launcher
preferred_launcher.install_action: Extract the licensed installer ZIP, close Minecraft and Prism, then run INSTALL-GTO-LICENSED.bat

account.licensed_prism_flow: A Microsoft account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition is required.
account.tlauncher_flow: The installer itself does not require a licensed account; server access depends on server authentication settings.

difficulty_model.warning: Do not copy a world created in GTO Normal or Expert into this Easy instance; GTO world mode is persistent and is not safely downgraded.

licensed: Download GTO-Friends-Licensed-Prism-Installer-v1.1.0.zip from GitHub Releases, not Source code.zip.
Extract the entire ZIP to a normal folder.
Close Minecraft and every Prism Launcher window.
Run INSTALL-GTO-LICENSED.bat and wait for successful verification.
In the bundled Prism Launcher add the licensed Microsoft account and launch the preconfigured GTO Friends instance.
tlauncher: Run any Minecraft version through TLauncher once, then close Minecraft and TLauncher.
Download GTO-Friends-TLauncher-Installer-v1.1.0.zip from GitHub Releases, not Source code.zip.
Extract the entire ZIP and run INSTALL-GTO-TLAUNCHER.bat.
Click the install button and remember the game directory shown by the installer.
Restart TLauncher, select that game directory and the local 1.20.1-forge-47.4.20 profile; forced update must remain off.
Leave Java selection automatic and assign 8192-12288 MiB RAM.

update_policy.method: Extract the matching 1.1.0 installer and run its INSTALL-*.bat against the existing folder; no full reinstall is needed.
update_policy.selected_mod_migration: Verify exact hashes and atomically change only the seven approved .jar.disabled names to .jar, then run exact final client verification.
preserve: licensed Prism account and launcher settings

verification.pinned_dependency_rule: Every CurseForge dependency uses an exact projectID and fileID; no latest-version resolution is permitted.
verification.success_condition: release script prints VERIFICATION PASSED and installed-client script prints CLIENT VERIFICATION PASSED

troubleshooting.dependency_download_failed: Retry later or open Prism settings and re-authenticate CurseForge if requested.
troubleshooting.out_of_memory: Set 8192-12288 MiB, close heavy applications, and do not allocate all system RAM.
troubleshooting.shader_missing: Verify Oculus and Euphoria Patcher are installed, launch once, then select the generated shader manually.
troubleshooting.server_mod_mismatch: Client 1.1.0 requires the server to have the same seven newly enabled mods. Run VERIFY-CLIENT.ps1 and update the server before connecting.
